subject: Backstage shadow: last-minute overnight reassign + hotel overflow plan
body:
From: Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@eventco.io
Date: 2026-11-27 08:12 PST
Subject: Urgent — two late cancellations, need overnight shadow coverage

Hey Karthik,

Quick heads up — two of our backstage shadow engineers (flight delayed/canceled) for tonight's twilight demo run just dropped. Venue security requires a 1:1 shadow for the VIP prep window (22:00–01:00 local). Can Redwood provide two last-minute shadow covers and one overnight float for badge/security handoff?

Current constraints:
- Flights: AA 231 and UA 899 both canceled; the replacements land very late (after 03:00).
- Hotel: the overflow block is full; we were able to negotiate 2 rooms at the chain across the street but they need names and ETA.
- Access: we must submit final badge manifest by 13:00 PST.

I realize this is short notice — Ben and I can cover logistics for expenses. Please advise asap so we can finalize shuttles.

Attachments: latest venue manifest (we'll need final names)

—Ben

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27 09:04 PST
Subject: Re: Urgent — two late cancellations, need overnight shadow coverage

Thanks Ben — on it. Quick plan below; will confirm volunteers in the next 30 min.

Immediate ask for Redwood field ops:
- Marissa: can you take the 22:00–01:00 VIP shadow? If yes, we'll put you on the shuttle.
- Mateo: can you cover the overnight float (door/badge handoff) 01:00–04:00?
- Grace: can you update the badge manifest and add backup phone numbers, then send to Ben (by 12:45)?

If anyone else on this thread can't do it, please propose an alternate. Ben — confirm pickup location for the shuttle (venue loading dock A or vendor gate 3).

I attached my temporary itinerary (itinerary_karthik_v2.pdf) with ETA windows in case we need to reroute.

—Karthik

> On 2026-11-27 08:12 PST, Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io> wrote:
> > Quick heads up — two of our backstage shadow engineers (flight delayed/canceled) for tonight's twilight demo run just dropped.
> > Venue security requires a 1:1 shadow for the VIP prep window (22:00–01:00 local).
>
---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27 09:26 PST
Subject: Re: Urgent — two late cancellations, need overnight shadow coverage

I can take the 22:00–01:00 VIP shadow slot.

Notes:
- I can be at Vendor Gate 3 for pickup at 21:05 (allowing time for check-in and badge prep).
- I have my own badge but will carry a printed manifest copy.
- I attached the quick itinerary I synced with Alexis (local ops). If we have to switch hotels, I'm flexible.

Attachment: marissa_itin_v1.pdf

—Marissa

---

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27 10:15 PST
Subject: Re: Urgent — two late cancellations, need overnight shadow coverage

I can cover 01:00–04:00 as overnight float. Shuttle detail from Ben: pick up at Loading Dock A at 00:50.

Logistics I will need from Ben/ops:
- Driver contact and shuttle plate number.
- Hotel confirmation for the two overflow rooms (hotel name and address).
- Any dietary restrictions for on-site engineers (we'll bring snack kits).

I updated the local manifest CSV with provisional names (see venue_room_manifest.csv attached). Grace — please add the backup phone numbers; Ben needs the final manifest by 13:00 PST.

—Mateo

---

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27 12:02 PST
Subject: Re: Urgent — two late cancellations, need overnight shadow coverage

Thanks team — I'm on badge manifest. I added two emergency contact numbers and mobile device IMEIs to the CSV per venue security policy. Final manifest attached (venue_room_manifest.csv).

Ben — please confirm hotel block at the "Foundry Suites" (across the street) and whether EventCo will cover incidentals for the two displaced engineers. I'll send to security once you confirm.

Also: request to reimburse taxi/shuttle for Marissa if vendor pickup misses the 21:05 window — please advise on expense workflow.

—Grace

---

From: Ben Strauss <ben.strauss@eventco.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-27 14:03 PST
Subject: Re: Urgent — two late cancellations, need overnight shadow coverage

All set — Foundry Suites confirmed (2 rooms until 07:00). Driver is Luis, cell +1 (415) 555-0124, shuttle plate CA-8XQZ. EventCo will cover incidentals up to $75/room — receipts to ops@eventco.io.

Thanks Karthik, Marissa, Mateo, Grace — really appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll update security with the manifest immediately.

—Ben

[Attachments included in thread: itinerary_karthik_v2.pdf (stated), marissa_itin_v1.pdf (stated), venue_room_manifest.csv (stated)]
